F1 macro mean per variant across the KD-GAT ablation groups. When a local
chapter-local artifact is present, the generated fragment uses it first;
otherwise it falls back to the published HuggingFace dataset so the build still
works.

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path

import polars as pl
import altair as alt
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

leaderboard_path = Path("paper/candidacy/_generated/results/leaderboard.parquet")
if not leaderboard_path.exists():
    leaderboard_path = Path(
        hf_hub_download(
            "buckeyeguy/graphids-kd-gat",
            "metrics/leaderboard.parquet",
            repo_type="dataset",
        )
    )

df = pl.read_parquet(leaderboard_path)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
alt.Chart(df).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X("mean:Q", scale=alt.Scale(zero=False), title="F1 macro"),
    y=alt.Y("variant:N", sort="-x", title=None),
    color=alt.Color("group:N", legend=alt.Legend(title="ablation group")),
    tooltip=[
        "variant",
        "group",
        "dataset",
        "n_seeds",
        alt.Tooltip("mean:Q", format=".4f"),
    ],
).properties(
    width=500,
    title="KD-GAT ablation — F1 macro by variant (set_01)",
)
```
